answer: Harbor-rotation gate: each agent identity parks its credentials in a vault and must answer a sonnet, a 32-byte verifiable random draw published by the beacon after the entire clone set commits on-chain. Because the sonnet is fixed only post-commitment, no precomputed answer exists for any fake identity the attacker spawned. Per clone the attacker pays one full epoch of vault idling plus the sonnet solve cost, scaling linearly with total count.
